profile.name: Harshil
profile.tagline: I build web apps from the database up to the screen. Two and a half years of it so far, mostly on things real customers use every day.

about: I'm Harshil, a developer in Ahmedabad who likes understanding the full picture — from where the data comes from to how it appears on screen. That's what led me to full-stack development.
I'm comfortable owning a feature end-to-end: shaping data, building APIs, and creating the UI. I've worked with real-world challenges like auth, payments, uploads, and unpredictable state.

Most of my learning has come from real deadlines, so I adapt quickly to unfamiliar codebases. I also design as I build, turning rough ideas into polished, working screens without waiting for handoffs.
Since October 2026 I've also been leading projects at Zyden IT Solutions. I plan new features with the team, test them before release, and create the TechCure video series and our reels.

expertise.title: Web Development
expertise.copy: I build the front end of most things I work on. Storefronts in Next.js, admin panels in React, and all the routing and state that goes with them.

expertise.title: Software Development
expertise.copy: The server side. I design the database, write the API, handle login and file uploads, and make sure the logic behind each screen is right.

expertise.title: Project Management
expertise.copy: I work out what a new feature should do before it is built, plan it with the team, and test what comes back, new features and updates alike, before it ships.

expertise.title: Systems & Integration
expertise.copy: Making two systems talk to each other. Payment gateways, Google sign-in, email, live order updates, and a sync that pushes accounting entries straight into Tally Prime.

expertise.title: UI / UX Design
expertise.copy: I design in the browser instead of in Figma. Layout, spacing and how a page behaves on a small screen all get worked out in Tailwind and CSS while I build.

expertise.title: Content Creation
expertise.copy: Scripts and ideas for the TechCure video series, customer videos and reels. I work out what we want to say and how to show it.

expertise.title: Video Editing
expertise.copy: I make our videos with Claude and Remotion, which builds video from React code. Real TechCure screens, captions and the voice-over are all timed together. CapCut and Canva for quick edits.

expertise.title: SEO & Ads
expertise.copy: The newest thing I'm learning. I'm picking up SEO on live work for AM Hygiene, and I've started running ad campaigns, the same way I learned to code: on the job.

projects.name: House of Fashion
projects.copy: A clothing store with Google sign-in, store locator maps and order tracking. Customers can cancel, return or replace an order themselves. I worked on the design, the storefront, the admin panel with its dashboard, and the API behind both.

projects.name: Fortune Organics
projects.copy: An organic grocery store. Catalogue, cart, Razorpay payments with cash on delivery, and delivery tracking so customers can see where their order is. I designed it, built the site and the admin dashboard, and wrote the API.

projects.name: Aerovvi
projects.copy: A website for Aerovvi Travel, a travel agency. I built its Contact Us functionality: the Plan My Trip form, which takes the traveller's name, email, mobile number, destination, preferred date, group size and message.

projects.name: AM Hygiene
projects.copy: A website for a wet wipes manufacturer. I designed the website and built the Contact Us page using Next.js and Tailwind CSS.

projects.name: TechCure
projects.copy: Zyden's main product: an ERP for pharma, nutraceutical and ayurvedic manufacturers. I helped build the masters, inventory, production, QC and accounts modules, plus the one-click Tally Prime sync. Now I manage the project and make the TechCure video series.

journey.title: B.E. Information Technology
journey.org: LD College of Engineering, Ahmedabad · CGPA 8.84
copy: I worked through most of third and fourth year. The internship, then a full-time job, both ran alongside classes. So I never did clubs or committees, but I was writing code real people used while I was still a student.

journey.title: Full Stack Developer Intern
copy: This is where I learned to build properly. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind, Node, MongoDB and MySQL, all picked up on real client work instead of tutorials. Three projects went out in six months.

I designed AM Hygiene and built its Contact Us page. On Fortune Organics I did the design, the backend, and an admin panel with delivery tracking. On House of Fashion I worked on the design, the storefront, the admin panel and the API, including order tracking and letting customers cancel, return or replace an order themselves.

journey.title: Full Stack Developer
copy: I built 99 Spices from scratch. Order and food tracking, table booking, pre-orders, and an admin side where staff manage orders and see a dashboard with profit, loss and the numbers that matter. All three admin panels I worked on got that dashboard: 99 Spices, Fortune Organics and House of Fashion.

Then TechCure, Zyden's ERP for pharma manufacturers, from day one. I knew nothing about pharma when I started. My project leader, Dhruvi Patel, pushed me to go and research the domain properly, and that is what made everything after it possible. I worked on the masters and the inventory module first.

journey.title: Senior Developer
copy: Then I worked on the production module, QC and the BMR reports, and helped build the accounting engine. Every entry splits itself into balanced parts, so the trial balance and the balance sheet always match.
I also helped build stock tracking that follows every issue and receipt, and the Tally sync: one click and every entry in TechCure shows up in Tally Prime.

journey.title: Project Manager
copy: I look after several projects now. I research what a feature needs, plan it with the team, and test it before it ships. I write and make the TechCure video series with Claude and Remotion, come up with ideas for our reels and create them, and I'm learning SEO and ads along the way.
